title: Bind fresh TVC admission to explicit VA provider execution preflight
originating_goal: Replace the expired static VA admission with same-run TVC admission and expose the exact remaining Master Records and explicit-authority blockers before any provider call.
release_condition: A VA-specific non-authorizing request template, authority validator, same-run TVC admission call, fail-closed preflight observer, recurring workflow, committed readiness receipt, canonical handoff update, and downstream issue transfer are present. Provider execution remains separately authorized and unexecuted.
collision_boundaries: Do not modify or dispatch the Ecosystem Chat provider workflow owned by issue #18.
Do not create an APPROVED authority receipt or infer approval from repository credentials.
Do not read or expose Master Records token values.
Do not request models:read or call a provider from the preflight workflow.
Do not claim custody, reconstruction, deployment, Site activation, filing, submission, representation, adjudication, rating, medical, or publication authority.
expected_evidence: The workflow calls the TVC reusable issuer pinned to commit d68318fc67ddb5ebf305a7fd1c6809d44dd6041e.
A fresh admission has exactly 900 seconds of validity and binds the current adapter commit plus admitted source and answer hashes.
Missing Master Records configuration is reported without exposing secret values.
Missing or invalid explicit provider authority is reported separately.
The preflight never requests provider permission and all authority/activation effects remain false.
next_after_release: An authorized owner may commit a valid VA-specific provider authority receipt for the exact route and caller commit.
Master Records endpoint, allowed-host, and token bindings must be configured in the protected execution environment.
Only then may a separate workflow_dispatch execution lane request models:read and perform one bounded provider call.
master-records/orchestration#15 then records custody and reconstruction.
